template.name: {value}_library
template.desc: {value}, morning: the title as the library, one material: paper cards on the sky, ink words on the sky. Top bar: the wordmark in ink (the version a caption on its baseline) with Avatars, Settings and Quit game beside it as quiet labelled tools; at the right end the Play together card on its paper with Resume under it. Under it the grid at the left, its cards' left edge on the wordmark's, and the map panel pinned at the right, its right edge on the card's plaque and its top on the cards'. The grid: Your maps (a text heading), New map (a solid paper face with one ink plus, New map with Advanced at its end, Generate and Import...), then the maps most recently played or edited first, each captioned with that date; real rendered thumbnails on Willow Green (the shipped Oak's Lab), Hayfield Rise, Violet Fen and Moonwell, placeholders a step deeper than the sky with a Fraunces initial on the rest; Willow Green says Updated in Blender on its picture. The grid clips at a hard edge. Willow Green selected: the panel shows its picture large, its name in the title face, the description, by Hannah, the source chip (Blender, edited here), 150 x 100 ft, 4 tokens, Played yesterday, Updated in Blender, then Play and Host with this map, Edit map and ..., Reload from Blender, all one height

steps.title: Library title
steps.intro: Produced by tools/render_jobs/jobs/library.json with probes/ui_library.gd (cards library-title and library-title-fix): the title as the library at 1280x720 (Auto 1.40) and 1920x1080 window sizes, then 1280x720 for the 200-250 ft warning, focus, hover and Delete's confirm. The library is staged (seven maps of every source, one Bundled; no level folder is read or written); four real thumbnails are rendered first (the shipped Oak's Lab and three maps made here from a seed and a landform); the strip's sizes and Blender check are staged, and the thumbnails, the import and Replace files and the edited level live under user://_library_title_probe/ with the levels folder pointed there until cleanup deletes it.
